title: Sharḥ al-Tajallī al-Dhātī
transliterated_title: Sharḥ al-Tajallī al-Dhātī (Commentary on the Essential [Divine] Self-disclosure; variants Sharḥ Kalimāt Ibn Hūd, Taṣḥīḥ Kalām Ibn Hūd al-Maghribī)
genre: 100-line versified commentary on a saying of Ibn Hūd al-Maghribī

date.basis: The entry gives no date; earliest listed copy is 1093/1682 (?) and none is in MS Majlis 10196.

manuscript: MS Princeton 2002/5 ff. 60a-62a (1093/1682 (?)); MS Nūrbakhsh 868/6; MS Sipahsālār 2930/7 ff. 121b-24a; MS Mishkāt 1033/5 ff. 8b-11b. None in MS Majlis 10196.
summary: A 100-line versified commentary on Ibn Hūd al-Maghribī's saying on the essential divine self-disclosure and the emergence of Throne and Footstool.
